positions.subject: q:government/expand-mayoral-authority
positions.summary: Her campaign site lists her vote as No on Proposition F, the November 2026 charter amendment that would expand the Mayor's authority over department heads, deputy mayors and the removal of commissioners.

citations.quote:
Proposition F:
Changes to Executive Branch Management
NO

Shall the City amend the Charter to expand the Mayor’s authority to transfer responsibilities between departments, hire deputy mayors, and hire some and fire most department heads; and to allow City officials to remove members of boards and commissions without cause?

positions.subject: q:transportation/local-tax-for-muni
positions.summary: Patel's campaign site lists her vote as Yes on Proposition H, the parcel tax to fund Muni operations, and says she will campaign for the Muni funding measures on the November 2026 ballot.

citations.quote:
Proposition H:
Parcel Tax to Fund Public Muni Operations
YES

Muni needs more money and better accountability. A $307 million fiscal cliff threatens routes across the city, and ballot measures this November will determine whether service survives. I'll campaign for that funding, because losing service is not an option.
citations.locator: Save Muni and Demand the Receipts
